paragraphs.text: Deepwood is a forest on Mercadia .

Deepwood is the sacred forest where Ramos fell. The outer part of the woods borders a series of swampy defiles guarded by undead ghouls , the risen corpses of victims of the planeshift to Mercadia . In the center of Deepwood is a clearing, where the dryad domain of Ouramos lies, holding the sacred Henge of Ramos . The telepathic and dangerous vine dryads of Deepwood guard this place, the grave and crash-landing site of Ramos, where his bones were housed.
